notes.title: DEMO HOTFIX RELEASED: Critical Bug Fixes & Comfort Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello Shop Owners!

Thank you for your overwhelming interest and valuable feedback on our DVD Store Simulator demo! To make your demo experience even smoother and more enjoyable, we've just released a quick hotfix. This patch includes critical bug fixes that could break the game, gameplay balancing, and some important revisions for a more comfortable gaming experience.

We've been working quickly to address these issues, some of which were identified through your feedback and others through our internal testing.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue occurring when adjusting the FOV setting.

Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't save after acquiring lights.

Resolved an issue where customer products at the cash register would not spawn correctly upon loading the game.

Fixed products spawning at the cash register falling to the ground.

Corrected the FPS adjustment dropdown options.

Fixed a bug where the POS system wouldn't accept single-digit numbers when taking payments.

Addressed an issue where keyboard inputs wouldn't work on the POS system in some keyboard layouts.

Fixed a brightness issue with in-store lights during game save/load states.

Improvements Made:

Reduced the rate of trash spawning inside the shop, making cleaning more manageable.

Interaction with the computer and cash register is now possible by clicking their screens, providing easier usability.

The duration of a day has been slowed down, allowing for more time within the game.

The "Open/Closed" sign outside the shop can now also be interacted with from inside.

Known Issues:

We are currently aware of and actively working on an issue where quitting the game takes a bit longer than expected in some situations. We aim to fix this in the next update.

Your feedback is incredibly helpful in improving our game! Please continue to share your experiences and suggestions with us.

Haven't tried the demo yet? Download it now on Steam and start building your dream DVD store!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773160/DVD_Store_Simulator_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

Don't forget to add our game to your Wishlist to be notified when the full version is released!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: DVD Store Simulator is officially part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
For the first time, you will be able to step into the shoes of a nostalgic shopkeeper and run your own DVD, figure and technology store.
Buy products, organize shelves, deal with customers and grow your store - all in a retro urban atmosphere.

🔸 What to Expect in the Demo:

 3 product categories to manage (DVDs, Figures, Tech)
 Shelf management, pricing, and customer sales
 Customization props and light decoration
 Day-night cycle & store cleaning
 Sound, localization (EN + TR), and more!

📝 Wishlist the game and get ready to open your doors on June 9.
Thanks for all your support — we can’t wait to hear what you think!

👉 Add to your Wishlist now!
